images.caption: Statue of Archbishop Khachatour Kesaratsi in front of the Vank Cathedral, Isfahan, Iran. He established the first publishing house in Persia (Iran) and Middle East in 1636 and printed the first book in Persia: Saghmosaran (the Psalter in Armenian). The first Persian book in Persia was published 192 years later in 1830.
images.alt: Statue of Archbishop Khachatour Kesaratsi in front of the Vank Cathedral, Isfahan, Iran. He established the first publishing house in Persia (Iran) and Middle East in 1636 and printed the first book in Persia: Saghmosaran (the Psalter in Armenian). The first Persian book in Persia was published 192 years later in 1830.
